    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbandonedShip

    AbandonedStation
    AbandonedStation class representing an event card.

    Interface for controllers that handle action settings in the GUI.

    This class represents advanced enemies in the game, which are a type of event card
    AssembledComponentException
     
    Battery
    Battery class represents a battery component in the game.
    Cabin
    Cabin class represents a cabin component in the game.
    Cannon
    Cannon class represents a cannon component in the game.
    CannonShot
    this class describes the size and orientation of a cannon shot that can hit the ships during the game
    CargoHold
    CargoHold class represents a cargo hold component in the game.
    CargoSpecial
    This class represents a special cargo hold.

    This class implements the RMI client, which is used to communicate with the RMI server.

    this class is used to represent the colors associated to the different players and to the different type of goods sored in "CargoHold" components
    CombatZone
    CombatZone class represents a event card.

    This class represents a generic component used to assemble the players' ships.

    This class represents components that can have two configurations, such as single or double.

    this class is used to represent the different type of connectors that can be associated to the sides of a component.

    This controller manages the graphic popup for the "crew landing" action

    Deck

    DefeatEnemyController
    This controller manages the graphic popup for the "defeat enemy" action
    Empty
    This class represents an empty position on a ship board.

    EndgameController
    Controller for the endgame screen.
    Engine
    This class represents an engine component in the game.

    FlightBoardControllerL1 is the controller for the Level 1 flight board
    FlightBoardControllerL2
    FlightBoardControllerL2 is the controller for the flight board in Level 2 of the game.

    FlightPhaseControllerL2

    FullCargoHoldException

    Controller for the game setup screen.

    GameUpdateType
    This enum represents the different types of game updates messages that can be sent

    ShipBoardControllerL2
    ShipBoardControllerL2 is the controller for the ship board in Level 2 of the game.

    This class contains all the methods needed to show a specific component of a ship board, including batteries, crew members, aliens, goods and providing the correct size and orientation of the component.

    Controller for the Shown Components screen in the Galaxy Trucker game.

    This class represents the smugglers event card.

    SocketServerHandler

    UseBatteriesController
    This controller manages the graphic popup for the "use batteries" action
    UserInterface
    Reference java interface for TUI and GUI user interfaces
    View
    View class represents a simplified copy (client-side) of the state of the game and of the players' ships, storing all the information needed to implement the TUI and the GUI consistently.
    ViewComponent
    ViewComponent class represents a simplified version (client-side) of the Component class (server-side)
    ViewDice
    ViewDice class stores the information of the dice of the game
    ViewFlightBoard
    ViewFlightBoard class represents a simplified version (client-side) of the FlightBoard class (server-side)
    ViewPlayer
    ViewPlayer class represents a simplified version (client-side) of the Player and ShipBoard classes (server-side)
    ViewPosition
    ViewPosition class represents a simplified version (client-side) of the Position class (server-side)
    VirtualServer
    This interface defines the methods that are used by the clients to interact with the server,
    VirtualServerRMI
    This interface defines the methods that are implemented by the RMI server, which can be invoked by the remote
    VirtualServerSocket
    This interface defines the methods that are invoked by the client to interact with the server.
    VirtualView
    Interface representing a virtual view in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    VirtualViewRMI
    This interface extends the VirtualView interface.
    VirtualViewSocket
    This interface defines the methods that are invoked by the model in order to notify/update the views after a change in the model; in particular, this interface is exploited if the chosen network technology is Socket
